systems.platform: Tridentity RDC SAS attended the ceremony; the platform itself is not named
systems.tiers: operational phase opened on 15 September 2026 with a first cohort of 50 enrolment agents, trained 16 to 26 September, before a gradual national scale-up

note: The minister says RDC-Pass is not a national identity card and does not stand in for the institutions in charge of civil registration; it is a secure digital access and authentication tool. Nothing on civil registration offices or how events are recorded.
